## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behaviour. Link the issue.

## Validation

List commands actually run, results and device/API where applicable. Distinguish synthetic responses, host renders and live/device tests.

## Review checks

- [ ] No credentials, signing keys, personal data, local databases or generated builds.
- [ ] Meaningful regression coverage for affected behaviour.
- [ ] Documentation and limitations match the implementation.
- [ ] Third-party notices/provenance retained; licensing status discussed with maintainer.
- [ ] UI changes include synthetic-data screenshots and accessibility checks where possible.
